source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes `04 00 12 82 01` while saying the receiver data must be confirmed.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED asks for vendor bus/address encoding, receiver identity, readback, delivery oracle and restore.

old_problem: The historical review correctly refused the placeholder and DeepSeek bytes but incorrectly treated the receiver encoding as vendor-specific. IPMI 2.0 sections 29.1-29.2 define the standard two-byte address/LUN request and Get Event Receiver readback. Remaining receiver identity, primary-IPMB routing, generator-local safe stimulus and recovery are Project execution bindings. The setter also re-arms all sensors and can immediately emit messages for pre-existing conditions, a safety/evidence effect absent from the prior test case.
disposition_reason: Use standard Sensor/Event NetFn 04h/Cmd 00h with exactly two bytes: an even IPMB receiver slave address and a LUN byte whose bits7:2 are zero. Capture baseline with 04h/01h, reject FFh disabling except under a separate explicit negative-test authority, set only an approved listening receiver, verify exact Get readback and deliver one controlled event generated by the target controller to that receiver, then restore and re-verify baseline routing. Start monitoring before Set because it re-arms internal sensors and may resend pre-existing asserted conditions. Never use DeepSeek's three bytes, clear SEL/logs, treat completion/readback as delivery proof, inject a fault without an isolated approved package, use Platform Event to bypass the generator route, retry automatically or leave routing changed.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1062-1065, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code is unique. Related OOB setter/getter rows 1190-1191 were directly read; setter row 1190 is variant ae93ed5614f4bc95 and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 68 was independently verified as row 1065 / variant e1b2eda8a798c1a6.

IPMI v2.0 section 29.1/Table 29-2 defines Set Event Receiver under Sensor/Event NetFn 04h, command 00h, for a management controller acting as an IPMB Event Generator. Request byte 1 is the receiver slave address and byte 2 contains only LUN bits1:0.

For a normal address, byte1 bits7:1 contain the 7-bit IPMB/I2C address and bit0 is zero. FFh is not an address: it disables Event Message generation entirely. Byte2 bits7:2 are reserved and must be zero.

DeepSeek's `12 82 01` supplies three bytes where the standard requires two and puts 0x82 into the LUN byte with reserved bits set. It cannot be sanitized by assuming the trailing byte or an undocumented bus/channel field.
Section 29.2/Table 29-3 defines Get Event Receiver 04h/01h returning the present address and LUN, providing exact baseline, post-write and restore readback without an OEM schema.

A successful Set only proves configuration acceptance and Get only proves stored routing. Functional coverage requires a real message produced by the configured generator and observed at the intended receiver with matching source/sensor/event identity; sending Platform Event directly to the receiver would bypass this route and cannot prove it.

Set Event Receiver re-arms event generation for every internal sensor. Existing asserted conditions may produce new messages, and slow sensors may temporarily report reading/state unavailable. Monitoring and evidence capture must begin before Set; those re-arm messages must be correlated rather than erased.

The target receiver, LUN, generator topology and non-disruptive event stimulus are platform-specific runtime inputs. A RAS/fault injection is not implied and requires its own ED-16 isolation/tool/recovery authority; otherwise use an approved benign generator-local sensor transition or keep execution NOT READY.

ED-03 resolves standard BMC semantics; ED-13/ED-15 constrain N/A; ED-16 gates error injection; ED-17 prohibits evidence deletion; ED-19 preserves IB/OOB identities; ED-28/ED-30 require recovery; ED-38 prohibits automatic test retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Set Event Receiver (IB 04h/00h) two-byte routing, delivery and restore
test_case.purpose: Configure the exact event generator reached through the local system interface to one approved IPMB event receiver/LUN, prove stored state and genuine end-to-end event delivery, then restore and re-prove the original route without disabling event generation, clearing evidence or conflating the separate OOB setter.
required_package: Approved chassis/BMC/firmware and local IPMI system interface; proof that the addressed controller is the intended IPMB Event Generator; primary-IPMB topology and stable generator identity
Baseline 04h/01h address/LUN, approved TARGET_RECEIVER_ADDRESS and TARGET_LUN, proof the receiver is present/listening, even-address/reserved-bit validation and an independent route/recovery channel

Owner-approved benign generator-local sensor/event stimulus with exact generator, SDR/sensor, assertion/deassertion, expected Event Request/SEL fields, cleanup and maximum observation window; separately approved isolation/tool/recovery if any injection is used
Versioned in-band runner using exactly `04 00 <address> <lun>` plus 04h/01h parser, receiver-side capture/correlation, exact baseline restore and explicit zero automatic test retries
Preserved pre-existing sensor state, SEL/audit/message-receiver baselines, monitoring active before Set, immediate approvals before each routing write/stimulus and an authorized engineer for verdicts
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED EVENT-ROUTING PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Do not clear SEL or logs. Identify the exact Event Generator reached through `-I open`; start generator sensor, SEL/audit and intended receiver capture before any Set. Read 04h/01h once and save BASE_ADDRESS/BASE_LUN; reject malformed reserved bits and stop if the owner has not approved how an FFh baseline will be restored. Validate TARGET as a real listening primary-IPMB receiver, TARGET_ADDRESS even and not FFh, and TARGET_LUN in 0-3 with bits7:2 zero. Display re-arm impact, existing asserted sensors, target and restore for immediate approval; send 04h/00h [TARGET_ADDRESS TARGET_LUN] exactly once and require completion 00h; read 04h/01h and require exact target bytes. Wait only the documented sensor scan window for reading/state-unavailable to clear while preserving any re-arm messages. With separate approval, create exactly one benign event at the configured generator—not a Platform Event sent directly to the receiver—and require a matching Event Request/receiver record with the approved generator/sensor/type/data/timestamp and no loss/misroute. Send 04h/00h [BASE_ADDRESS BASE_LUN] exactly once, require exact 04h/01h baseline, then use one separately approved benign event to prove the baseline destination again. Correlate and retain all re-arm events. Never send `12 82 01`, FFh, an unknown address/LUN, a direct Platform Event substitute, an unapproved fault/RAS injection, clear logs, retry or continue after failed restore.
test_case.expected_result: The target Set returns completion 00h and Get returns exactly the approved even address and LUN with reserved bits zero. Pre-existing/re-arm messages are attributable and retained. The one approved generator-local stimulus produces the expected logical event at the target receiver with matching generator, sensor/event data and time, while non-target destinations show no unintended route. Restore returns 00h, Get exactly matches BASE, and a separate approved event follows the baseline route again. The generator, receiver, unrelated sensors, SEL/audit history and management access remain healthy. Wrong length/reserved bits, FFh, readback mismatch, lost/misrouted/duplicate logical event, direct Platform Event bypass, unexpected re-arm effect or incomplete restore is FAIL/NOT READY without retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact Source Key/variant, the correct two-byte 04h/00h request, authoritative generator/receiver topology, 04h/01h baseline and target equality, monitoring before re-arm, genuine generator-originated delivery evidence, exact restore and baseline-route revalidation. Placeholder data, DeepSeek `12 82 01`, command success alone, Get-only proof, FFh disabling, direct Platform Event sent to the receiver, cleared SEL, unapproved injection, OOB setter evidence substituted for this IB identity, automatic retry or incomplete restoration cannot pass. N/A requires authoritative proof that the addressed controller is not an IPMB Event Generator or the standard command is unsupported.
safety_gate: Use only the local system interface for this setter identity. The OOB route is observation/recovery; row 1190 remains distinct coverage.
Capture Get baseline and prove the target receiver is live before writing. Do not use FFh, odd/unknown addresses or a LUN byte with any reserved bit set.
Begin sensor, receiver and SEL/audit capture before Set because Set re-arms every internal sensor and can generate messages for existing asserted conditions. Never clear that evidence.
Use one approved benign generator-local stimulus. Any RAS/error injection requires an isolated environment, approved tool and recovery; absent those, the functional step is NOT READY.
Do not use Sensor/Event Platform Event directed to the receiver as routing proof: it enters at the receiver and bypasses the configured generator destination.
No automatic test retry. On readback or delivery ambiguity, stop stimuli, preserve both endpoints, restore BASE once when safe, verify Get and hand any remaining recovery to the platform owner.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; chassis/BMC/firmware/local-interface and target-generator identity; official two-byte schema; distinct row-1190 OOB Source Key/variant
Raw/decoded 04h/01h baseline; primary-IPMB topology; approved target receiver/LUN; listener health; existing sensor-state and re-arm impact inventory
Versioned runner hash, immediate approvals, redacted target Set/completion and exact Get comparison with reserved-bit validation
Timestamp-correlated generator stimulus, source/sensor/type/data, receiver Event Request/SEL record and non-target route observations, with re-arm messages separately identified
Redacted baseline restore/completion/Get equality and separate baseline-route delivery proof; preserved sensor, SEL/audit and management health
PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A and engineer verdict, explicitly recording no DUT command, routing change or event injection by the review agent
test_case.recovery: Before target Set, precompute 04h/00h [BASE_ADDRESS BASE_LUN] and keep an independent route to the generator. If target completion/readback is ambiguous, create no stimulus and restore baseline once only when safe. If delivery is lost or misrouted, stop all event generation, preserve generator/receiver/SEL evidence, restore the exact baseline once and verify 04h/01h; use an approved benign baseline event only after the route is stable. If restore fails, the owner uses the documented independent BMC/IPMB recovery. Never use FFh as emergency suppression, clear logs, inject another event or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the request schema and readback: the review layer replaces the placeholder with exactly address+LUN, rejects DeepSeek's three malformed bytes and replaces success-only Criteria with Get, genuine delivery and restore evidence.

blocked.reason: Core command, fields, disable semantics, readback and re-arm behavior are standardized. Exact generator/receiver identities, safe stimulus and recovery are bounded Project execution inputs.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 29.1-29.2/Tables 29-2 and 29-3 define Sensor/Event 04h/Cmd00h address+LUN request, FFh disable meaning, reserved bits, generator applicability, all-sensor re-arm behavior and 04h/Cmd01h present-setting readback.

project_authority: BMC/IPMB owners identify the exact event generator and primary-IPMB receiver, approve target address/LUN, receiver capture, benign generator-local stimulus, re-arm handling and recovery, and issue verdicts. Any RAS/error injection needs separate isolated approval. Owners cannot approve the malformed example, FFh disabling by default, log clearing, Get-only or direct-Platform-Event routing proof, automatic retry, lost event coverage or incomplete restore.
